dusk-violet.$description: Dusk Violet — Primary canvas and hero background — the stage that every other color performs on

hi-vis-yellow.$description: Hi-Vis Yellow — Yellow accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

buttery-yellow.$description: Buttery Yellow — Secondary display text and softer borders — a mellower sibling of Hi-Vis for when Hi-Vis would be too much

lilac-shadow.$description: Lilac Shadow — Card and block backgrounds — a deeper violet for nested surfaces on the violet stage

bubblegum-pink.$description: Bubblegum Pink — Decorative borders and confetti accent — a warm pink used sparingly for pop

matcha-cream.$description: Matcha Cream — Decorative borders and confetti accent — a dusty sage for the secondary cast of cards

magenta-punch.$description: Magenta Punch — Accent card surface — reserved for standout blocks that need to scream louder than the stage

firecracker-red.$description: Firecracker Red — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Body text, primary borders, and outlined button strokes — the near-black that does typographic work on cream surfaces

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Hard borders, icons, and text on yellow surfaces — pure black where maximum edge contrast is needed

obviouslyvariable.$description: Display and large heading family — the only font loud enough for the system. Sizes scale from 18px body uses up to 341px poster-scale display. Tight 0.80–1.00 leading makes multi-line headlines stack into solid color blocks; calt is disabled so the wide geometric forms stay unornamented. Substitute: Founders Grotesk Condensed, Knockout, or Druk Wide.

degularvariable.$description: Ultra-small UI text — nav, footer micro-copy, and inline labels at 10px. The neutral workhorse that disappears next to the display voice. Substitute: Inter, IBM Plex Sans.

bergenmonoregular.$description: Monospaced micro-type for nav, tags, and small data labels — provides a typewriter rhythm against the rounded display. The 0.80 leading on monospace is signature: mono stacked tight feels like a receipt. Substitute: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono.

degulardisplay-bold.$description: Small bold body text for CTAs, button labels, and emphasized micro-copy. The 0.05em tracking opens the letterforms enough to read at 16px without crowding. Substitute: Degular Bold, Söhne Bold.
